name: Elongated Ear Modification
description: Elongates and reshapes the human ear pinna into a pointed, elfin configuration — taller, narrower, and tapering to a point. Unlike the cat ear modification which replaces the entire ear structure, elf ears extend the existing human ear shape upward and to a point. The modification is purely cosmetic — it provides no functional hearing enhancement. The ears range from subtly pointed (barely noticeable) to dramatically elongated (15–20 cm tip-to-lobe). The cartilage is living and flexible, moving slightly with facial expressions. Elf ears have been fashionable in GLMZ for decades, cycling through periods of being mainstream and periods of being retro. Currently, they're considered classically elegant — the little black dress of cosmetic geneware. Combined with other cosmetic modifications, they contribute to the deliberately non-human aesthetic that many GLMZ residents cultivate.
source_organism: Synthetic cartilage elongation factors (no organism source)
manufacturer: Widespread availability — every gene clinic offers this
procedure: Auricular cartilage retroviral injection, single session
reversibility: Fully reversible with cartilage dissolution and regrowth
side_effects: Ear tips are cold-sensitive due to thin cartilage
Dramatic elongation may cause ear tips to droop over time
Budget versions may produce asymmetric results
Ears catch on collars, hoods, and headphones
social_perception: Timeless and elegant. Elf ears never fully go out of fashion in GLMZ. They're the modification that your grandmother had and your grandchildren will have. Subtle points are considered refined; dramatic points are considered bold.
story_hooks: An elf-ear fashion revival coincides with a cultural movement reclaiming 'fantasy' identity in a world where everyone is already modified — if the modified body is the default, then fantasy aesthetics become the new normal

A gene clinic's elf-ear package is contaminated with a pigment modifier that turns the ear tips blue over 6 months — an accidental genetic watermark that identifies every client of that specific clinic
